*Planet to House Conjunction Rule*
1. A planet that comes within the Orb boundary of the next house in the same Zodiac will give the result of the next house
2. A planet that crosses the main door of the house will give the result of the house
3. A planet in the vacant zodiac will give the result of the house in the previous zodiac
4. A planet can never give the result of the house in the next zodiac even if it comes within the orb.
*Planet to Planet Conjunction Rule*
1. A planet that comes within the Orb boundary of a nearby planet in the same Zodiac will modify the result of the nearby planet
2. A planet in two different zodiacs will never be conjunct
3. A conjunct planet will first give the result of its star lord and then it will give its own signification
4. Sun will conjunct a planet if it is within 6° 40'. But, the nearby planet will only conjunct Sun if it is within 3° 20'.
5. If a house wall separates the planets, then they are not conjunct with each other.
*Planet to Planet Opposition Rule*
1. A planet opposes another planet if it is within the orb of 180°
2. Rahu and Ketu will always oppose each other
3. If a planet is conjunct with Rahu or Ketu it will automatically oppose Ketu or Rahu
4. If a house wall separates the planets, then they are not opposing each other.
